findings.title: Twice-interrupted native capture still loses returned spend and allows duplicate simulation dispatch after owner checkpoint replacement
findings.smallest_reproduction: Construct synthetic battery desk with following reader returning live owner dicts; save pre-execution canonical ledger; dispatch once and settle run.1; interrupt _retain_handing at entry on both initial capture and immediate recovery; restore owner mapping entry to saved ledger; dispatch original authorization again. See probe_handing_boundary.py retention_and_cleanup_interrupted.
findings.expected_result: Original dispatch authorization must be refused after a verification was handed the spent state, including when authoritative comparison was interrupted. No second simulated execution.
findings.trust_scope: Within documented returned-handing guarantee: exact owner records, ordinary mapping replacement by canonical checkpoint, injected asynchronous interruption checkpoints. No private reader mutation, invented evidence, serializer trick, unadmitted action or external provider execution.
findings.novelty: Known OPEN family independently reproduced on R17, alias R16-B-2. Not a new repair regression.
findings.proposed_correction: Select execution-owner retained handoff/publication lifetime contract preserving a stable observation across owner restore until authoritative comparison acknowledgement. Do not silently narrow observation to successful capture. Sentinel/local retry handles one-shot registration but cannot reconstruct content absent from all retained state after both captures abort. Permanent poisoning solely for interruption violates honest-reader availability; arbitrary retries do not establish complete preservation.
